usedFor: Autopilot holds clients, jobs, estimates and invoices, and Microsoft Excel receives them as rows through “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice” in Autopilot, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new invoice becomes a row in an Excel table, so billing sits in one sheet.

watchOut: “Updated Job” runs on every job update, so “Add Row To Table” can repeat a job; use the status filter.
